Step 1: 10-12-1643 is DD-MM-YYYY → 1643-12-10.  
Step 2: Add 95 days.  
December has 31 days: from Dec 10 → 21 days left in Dec (31 - 10 = 21).  
95 - 21 = 74 days left to add.  
Step 3: January 1644 has 31 days → 74 - 31 = 43 days left.  
February 1644 is a leap year (1644 divisible by 4) → 29 days → 43 - 29 = 14 days left.  
Step 4: March 1 + 14 days = March 15, 1644.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1644-03-15
